[[File:Order66effects avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|order66effects.]]
'''order66effects''' is a creator whose image is used on five [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of order66effects @ Instagram". The credit points to Instagram, a photo-sharing site. The credited cards are [[Plo Koon (V) (ALT)|•Plo Koon (V) (AI)]], [[Ninth Sister|•Ninth Sister]], [[A Sith Legend|•A Sith Legend]], [[Tarfful|•Tarfful]], and [[Grummgar|•Grummgar]], in [[Virtual Set 10]], [[Virtual Set 13]], [[Virtual Set 16]], and [[Virtual Set 17]] (released 2019–2021).
